hero.description: Elegant live piano music for events, hotels, dinner evenings and exclusive occasions.

about.title: Professional jazz pianist
about.text1: I graduated from the Liszt Ferenc Academy of Music, Jazz Piano Department, where I received classical and modern jazz training.
about.text2: As an active performer, I play solo, duo and in various ensembles, mainly in high-quality live music environments such as hotels, jazz clubs and exclusive events.
about.text3: I also teach piano. I work with beginners and advanced students, including children, focusing on making music education inspiring and enjoyable.
about.name: Ganyi Róbert

contact.title: Book a performance
contact.description: Available for events, dinner evenings, hotel performances and exclusive occasions. Own Yamaha digital piano available on request.
